# Game icons

The painted icons in the HUD and menus (src/ui/icon-paths.js, drawn by src/ui/icons.js) are from
**game-icons.net** (https://game-icons.net, https://github.com/game-icons/icons), by Lorc, Delapouite
and the other contributors credited at https://game-icons.net/about.html.

They are licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported license
(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/). Changes made here: only the icons the game uses are
kept, their coordinates are rounded to whole units of the 512-unit box (tools/build-icons.mjs), and the
game fills them with its own gradients and outlines.

Copied from the npm package @iconify-json/game-icons 1.2.4.
